Author: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Date:   Sat Jan 31 08:42:26 2026 +0000

    Add hidden validate command for Dark Software Factory pattern
    
    This adds an experimental `entire validate` command (hidden) that runs
    configurable proof checks to verify code quality. This is the first step
    toward implementing autonomous validation workflows.
    
    Features:
    - Configure proofs in .entire/settings.json under strategy_options.validation
    - Each proof is a shell command that must exit 0 to pass
    - Proofs can be marked as required or optional
    - Supports JSON output for automation (--json flag)
    - Filter to specific proof types (--proof flag)
    - 10-minute timeout per proof
    
    Example configuration:
      {
        "strategy_options": {
          "validation": {
            "enabled": true,
            "proofs": [
              {"type": "test", "command": "mise run test", "required": true},
              {"type": "lint", "command": "mise run lint", "required": true}
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    
    This lays the groundwork for Level 5 "Dark Software Factory" automation
    where AI agents can self-validate their work before committing.
